description: This file contains utility functions for handling inbound email options and user signatures within the SuiteCRM system, including functions to retrieve email distribution options, user signatures, and generate signature selection HTML.

methods.name: getInboundEmailDistributionOptions
methods.description: Returns HTML for inbound email distribution options based on view context.

methods.name: getUserSignature
methods.description: Retrieves the user signature for an inbound email, considering view context and preferences.

methods.name: getInboundEmailSignatures
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element with user signatures for inbound emails.
